concept.hr: Stari odgovor živi dok mu TTL ne istekne: TTL se snizuje prije selidbe
concept.en: Old answers live until their TTL expires: lower the TTL before you move

summary.hr: Adresa se promijeni u 0, a tri rezolvera daju staru dok im zapis ne istekne. TTL snižen na vrijeme skraćuje prozor na pet minuta.
summary.en: The address changes at 0, and three resolvers hand out the old one until their record expires. A TTL lowered in time cuts the window to minutes.
